# Scouting with the BSA Outside the U.S.

The World Organization of the Scout Movement (WOSM), of which Scouting America
is a member, is divided into six regions: Africa, Arab, Asia-Pacific, Eurasia,
Europe, and Interamerica.

**If you’re moving or live outside of the United States, you can continue to
be a member of Scouting America** through the three BSA councils providing
service to BSA members participating in BSA Scouting programs outside of the
U.S.

See the map below for the service areas of these councils along with their
contact information.

Click on the gold info icon for each service area to get started and find out
more:

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/BSA.Outside.US_.png) [
__ ](https://www.ncacbsa.org/) [ __ ](https://www.tac-bsa.org/) [ __
](https://www.fareastcouncil.org/)

Three councils handle both Lone Scouting and Unit-based programs for BSA
members living within their service area:

## National Capital Area Council

For countries in North, Central, and South America, and the Caribbean, contact
the **National Capital Area Council** :

  * **Phone:  **301-530-9360
  * Website: [ncacbsa.org/directservice/](http://www.ncacbsa.org/directservice/)  
  * **Email:**  [DirectService@NCACBSA.org](mailto:DirectService@NCACBSA.org)
  * **Address:  **National Capital Area Council, Direct Service; 9190 Rockville Pike, Bethesda, MD 20814-3897

## Transatlantic Council, BSA

For countries in the European, Arab, Eurasia, and Africa regions:

  * **Phone:  **CIV: +32 2 717 9726
  * Website: <https://tac-bsa.org/>   
  * **Email:**  [TAC-ServiceCenter-802@scouting.org](mailto:TAC-ServiceCenter-802@scouting.org "mailto:TAC-ServiceCenter-802@scouting.org")**  
**

  * **Address:  **Transatlantic Council, BSA; USAG Brussels, Unit 28100; Box 24, APO AE 09714

## Far East Council, BSA

For countries in the Asia-Pacific Region:

  * **Phone:**_(within Japan)_ 098-971-9014     _(international)_ +81-98-971-9014
  * Website:[ fareastcouncil.org/](http://www.fareastcouncil.org/) 
  * **Email:**  [ membership@fareastcouncil.org](mailto:membership@fareastcouncil.org)**  
**

  * **Address:  **Far East Council BSA; Unit 35049, FPO AP 96373-5049

For more information about WOSM regions and the list of countries that they
serve, please see below and select the appropriate region.
